thread:
Sam Wells: FYI I opened a tiny TF change in infra/gateway to switch the staging inference-gateway svc from tlsPassthrough=true -> false so ALB can terminate. Can someone sanity-check healthchecks/secretbinding impacts? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123
Julia Chen: quick q — why terminate at ALB vs passthrough for staging?
Sam Wells: want host-based routing for multiple model endpoints without per-node certs. Also trying the ALB rewrite rules on path-based routing.
Lee Parker: heads-up: if you terminate at ALB we need the SecretBinding in gateway-api to reference the ALB cert secret (namespace infra-ingress). Otherwise SNI fallback will hit default cert.
Sam Wells: noted, I added a SecretBinding resource in the PR:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1
kind: TLSSecretBinding
metadata:
  name: inference-alb-binding
  namespace: infra-ingress
spec:
  secretRef:
    name: alb-inference-cert
  gateways:
    - inference-gateway
```
SRE Oncall: quick operational check — if externalTrafficPolicy is Local and ALB healthcheck uses nodeport, could see 504s if no pods on that node. Make sure externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster or add node port on all nodes.
Sam Wells: current svc has externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster, I left it. PR toggles annotation only: service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-proxy-protocol: tcp -> removed.
infra-bot: plan applied for branch sam/wip-gateway-terminate (infra/gateway): 1 to update, 0 to destroy. See plan summary: https://ci.redwood.ai/plan/7842 :gear:
Julia Chen: small nit — update terraform var description for gateway_tls_mode and add note in CHANGELOG for rollback steps.
Sam Wells: good call, updated the var doc and added rollback steps in PR description.
eng-platform-bot: pinging @eng-platform for review — request assigned to Lee Parker :eyes:
Lee Parker: reviewed, left 2 tiny comments about annotation naming and secret rotation window. Also flagging that secret alb-inference-cert rotates monthly; ensure rollout during non-rotation window. :calendar:
Sam Wells: will hold the canary overnight for 2 hours in staging, then promote if no errors. Rollback plan: revert the tf commit and reapply previous svc annotation (script in PR).
Sam Wells: script to rollback if needed:
```bash
git revert <commit> --no-commit && terraform apply -auto-approve
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-gateway -n inference
```
Julia Chen: :thumbsup: ping if you want me to kick healthcheck smoke tests after canary.
SRE Oncall: I'll watch metrics and set a 30min alert for 502/504 spike on inference-gateway-prod.
Sam Wells: thanks all — I'll merge after one more signoff and post canary start time.
